conditions.conditions: Sequential 21 coding trials across seven models after all browser trials finished. No additional paid lab calls, builds, or tests during matrix. Fixed source/build and untouched task prompts/graders. Provider load, cache warmth, and user activity uncontrolled.
conditions.scope: Coverage, one trial per task/model. Ledger and LRU holdouts are not tuned against failures. Generated cli/bench/history.jsonl is expected to change; no implementation source changes allowed.

originalArtifacts: Dedicated lab measurements/expanded-matrix-4a4a0539; original per-model files and audit sidecars retained.

oracleGapEvidence.method: After matrix process exited 0, invoke retained Sonnet implementations with exact stated-contract counterexamples. No model retry or workspace edit.

limitations: One trial per task/model; coverage, not repeated reliability or universal superiority.
Strict acceptance includes post-run exact-session scope audits. Original automated outputs and legacy scores are retained separately.
The two strengthened hidden checks were applied to every original implementation after the matrix ended. User task prompts and seed files are unchanged.
Later targeted confirmations after guidance changes are development tests, not new blind holdout evidence.
